hero.title: Sattvam: Experience the Art of Satvic Delicacies
hero.subtitle: Savor an unforgettable culinary journey with an epic spread of pure Indian and Continental cuisine, crafted for your well-being.

about.title: The Sattvam Story: A Decade of Wholesome Excellence
about.paragraph1: For over a decade, **Sattvam Restaurant** has been a beacon of pure, wholesome dining, dedicated to serving the finest satvic delicacies. With four esteemed outlets across Bangalore and Hyderabad, we've cultivated an unforgettable culinary experience that harmonizes tradition with modern tastes, celebrating the art of mindful eating.
about.paragraph2: At Sattvam, every dish is a meticulously crafted creation from our epic spread of Indian and Continental cuisine, designed to nourish both body and soul. We invite you to explore endless choices and rich flavors, confident that each bite embodies our unwavering commitment to quality, purity, and your complete dining satisfaction.
